changed_questions.question: What is the average order total by order status?
changed_questions.generated_sql: SELECT status, AVG(total_amount) AS avg_total FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY avg_total DESC LIMIT 100
changed_questions.orig_ref_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY count DESC;
changed_questions.rev_ref_sql: SELECT status, ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total FROM orders GROUP BY status;

changed_questions.question: What are the 5 cities with the most registered customers?
changed_questions.generated_sql: SELECT c.city, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers AS c GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5
changed_questions.orig_ref_sql: SELECT city, state, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city, state ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5;
changed_questions.rev_ref_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(customer_id) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY city ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5;

changed_questions.question: What was the completed order revenue drop or gain (Q2 minus Q1) between Q1 and Q2 of 2024 using conditional aggregation?
changed_questions.generated_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) = '2024' AND STRFTIME('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q1_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) = '2024' AND STRFTIME('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q2_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) = '2024' AND STRFTIME('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) = '2024' AND STRFTIME('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_change FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' LIMIT 100
changed_questions.orig_ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q1_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q2_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_diff FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024';
changed_questions.rev_ref_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q1_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q2_revenue, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('04', '05', '06') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%m', order_date) IN ('01', '02', '03') THEN total_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_diff FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024';

changed_questions.question: Compute month-over-month revenue growth percentage for completed orders in 2024.
changed_questions.generated_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT STRFTIME('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND STRFTIME('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY month) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND((revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month LIMIT 100
changed_questions.orig_ref_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) SELECT month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_month_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month ASC;
changed_questions.rev_ref_sql: WITH monthly_rev AS (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND strftime('%Y', order_date) = '2024' GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', order_date)) SELECT month, revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM monthly_rev ORDER BY month ASC;
